thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed in region us-west-2 (gateway-pool-7). Paging on-call.

maria: ack — I'm on it. seeing a jump in 502/504 from the gateway logs starting ~10:10 UTC. metrics: 5xx rate ~8% (baseline 0.3%).

devon: @maria any customer-facing errors? support dashboard shows multiple active sessions with failed responses.

support-bot: Affected customers: cust-alpha (high traffic), analytics-job-42 (batch), 3 dev seats. Error surface: intermittent 502/504, some streaming aborts.

maria: quick triage notes: gateway returns upstream "backend-unavailable" for a subset of backend instances. tailing proxy logs:

```
2026-03-06T10:12:02Z gateway[gw-7]: upstream=svc-infer-az1 502 "upstream reset" instance=infra-ml-002
2026-03-06T10:12:05Z gateway[gw-7]: upstream=svc-infer-az2 504 "kv-cache-timeout" key=kv:user:cache miss
```

lia: interesting — we see KV (redis) latency spikes in us-west-2: p95 from 8ms -> 120ms around same timeframe. Could be causing request latency and cascading timeouts.

jason: I'm on infra. checking node-level metrics now. node drain activity recorded by autoscaler around 10:08 for group inference-pool-7. Several pods got rescheduled.

maria: hypothesis: rescheduling + cold-KV-cache misses -> CPU/latency spike on a subset of model-serving pods leading to gateway 5xx. Need to confirm if model-serving pods are OOMing or just cold-starting.

devon: can we quickly fail traffic to a fallback region? set routing policy to steer 40% -> us-east-2 while we mitigate.

ops-pager: Paging ops-sre for hands-on infra changes: @sre-rotation please advise if we should trigger cross-region fallback.

sre-rotation: I'm up. Agree with temporary steer. But first small mitigation: increase per-instance connection limits and raise circuit breaker threshold to avoid aggressive tripping while we stabilize.

elaine: rolling change queued: bump circuit_breaker_threshold from 0.6 -> 0.85 for gateway-pool-7. Applying now.

maria: applying redirect policy: set route "us-west-2->us-east-2" weight 40%. CLI snippet used:

```
redwood route update --region us-west-2 --fallback us-east-2 --weight 40 --dry-run=false
```

incident-bot: Incident created INC-20260306-1719. Severity: high (partial regional outage). Notifying Pager and Support.

jason: infra notes: autoscaler triggered due to pod restart storms; looking at kube events there's a pattern: image pull delays + ephemeral disk pressure on 3 nodes in us-west-2 zone B.

lia: redis team — are there any eviction logs? I see hot key churn on prefix `kv:user:`. Suggest enabling multi-get batching to reduce pressure.

devon: ok while infra stabilizes we're steering traffic and bumping pool capacity. Request to SRE: spin up 4 extra inference instances in us-west-2 (warm) and increase sticky caching window to reduce KV lookups.

sre-rotation: provisioning +1 dedicated pool (4 instances) queued. ETA ~6 minutes. Also disabled autoscaler profile `aggressive-scale-v2` to prevent more disruptive reschedules.

maria: observed partial recovery: 5xx rate down from 8% -> 2.1% after routing change and cb bump. Latency p99 improved from 2.8s -> 1.1s for routed traffic.

support-bot: update: customer alpha reports successful retries for most requests but intermittent failures remain for long-stream sessions. Recommending informing top 10 customers preemptively.

elaine: restarting the three affected pods one-by-one to repopulate KV caches. Doing rolling restart with 30s grace.

jason: disk pressure caused by ephemeral log rotate bug — patch landed to prevent large local logs. Will roll to nodes after pods stabilized.

maria: summary so far: immediate mitigations executed: 1) route steer 40% to us-east-2 2) raised cb threshold 3) spun up 4 extra warm instances 4) disabled aggressive autoscaler 5) rolling restarts of affected pods. Monitoring for 30m before full rollback.

devon: customer-impact assessment: P1-> high for region us-west-2 only. Affected sessions ~0.7% of global traffic, but includes a handful of enterprise customers with stringent SLOs.

lia: monitoring: setting an alert to notify if 5xx >1% for next 15m in us-west-2. Also creating an eval job to replay sample failing requests against warmed instances.

incident-bot: Update logged at 2026-03-06T10:34Z: mitigation steps executed; escalation to infra + redis + support. Incident lead: maria. Handoff planned in 45m.

sre-rotation: handing off to night SRE at 11:00 UTC @lia will take next watch. I'll leave runbook notes in the incident doc: - keep route steer on until caches warm - do not re-enable aggressive-scale-v2 - watch redis p95 and queue depth - plan controlled rollback once 5xx < 0.5% for 20m

lia: ack — taking over. will monitor and coordinate with support for customer comms. Please post any further changes here.

support-bot: Notifying top customers with template: "We observed elevated errors in us-west-2 between 10:10-10:40 UTC. We have mitigations in place (traffic steering + added capacity). We'll follow up with post-incident notes." Template posted to #support-comm.

maria: final note before handoff: follow-up action items: 1) root cause RCA for autoscaler + ephemeral disk interplay 2) redis hot-key mitigation and batching improvements 3) revisit default circuit breaker thresholds 4) add synthetic checks for KV latency in us-west-2

devon: thanks everyone. keeping incident open until lia confirms stable metrics for 30m. Good job on quick mitigation.

incident-bot: Incident status: monitoring. Last update 2026-03-06T11:00Z.
